blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del — Basilan Governor Mujiv Hataman has strongly condemned the brazen killing of Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 2 Judge Joseph Wee Sit, calling the assassination a direct assault on the country’s justice system. Judge Wee Sit was reportedly shot in Zamboanga City early Thursday, November 12. In a strongly worded statement, Hataman expressed outrage and sorrow over the tragedy, warning that the murder of a magistrate threatens the independence and safety of the judiciary.
